title: Handball Punch The Pill (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, you cant throw the ball in this game
Handball or kick, those are the two
Punch the pill with a closed fist

[Verse 1]
Hold the ball flat in the open palm of one hand
The other hand makes a fist, knuckles up to stand
Punch the bottom of the ball with the closed fist
The ball pops up to the receiver, dont miss

[Pre-Chorus]
Never throw, son, never lob with two hands
The umpire calls throw and the other team stands
Closed fist contact only, that is the rule
Handball is the short pass tool

[Chorus]
Handball punch the pill, son
Closed fist contact, the work begun
Open palm holds the ball flat
Fist punches up, never the throw bat

[Verse 2]
Use the handball when the kick is blocked
Use the handball when the receiver is close docked
Five metres or less, son, handball wins
Quick release, in tight, no spins

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the handball is the chess move
Keeps the ball alive in tight space groove
In the centre square stoppage handball wins
Quick hands, quick decisions, son, no sins

[Chorus]
Handball punch the pill, son
Closed fist contact, the work begun
Open palm holds the ball flat
Fist punches up, never the throw bat

[Outro]
Open palm, closed fist
Punch the pill, never miss
Five metres or less
Thats my boy, handball success
